thread:
mira: Heads-up: preparing engine kernel v3.4.0-quant for canary tonight in the 23:00 UTC quiet window. Deploybot will run a 1% canary first. I'm planning to pin runtime variants for 48h if green. :eyes:

jon: FYI QA found a throughput regression with long prompts on the last build (matmul path). Repro steps in staging below:
```
python bench.py --prompt-file=long_prompts.txt --model=engine:v3.4.0-quant --tokens=2048
```
Throughput drops ~20% p95 vs v3.3.x

mira: Thanks — can you attach the staging logs? If it's KV cache related we should hold the pin.

jon: attaching snippet (https://internal.ci/logs/ci-1234) — looks like matmul fallback shows higher GPU util. Not hitting OOM, just perf.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: engine:v3.4.0-quant -> canary=1% at 2026-03-22T23:00Z. Pin TTL=48h unless manual unpin.

tess: If we pin, let's reduce canary to 0.5% and extend ramp to 24h for safer signal. Also need release notes blurb for quant kernel changes.

elena: QA re-ran with quantized kernels + prefetch disabled; perf aligns w/ v3.3. So config flag matters. Suggest marking config as 'PREFETCH=false' as opt-in for now.

mira: Proposal: run canary 0.5% with PREFETCH=false, collect p50/p95 latency, token throughput, memory. If metrics stable at 24h, pin for 48h; otherwise rollback to v3.3.x and open hotspot ticket.

andy: +1. Who's writing release notes? I can draft short note on kernel/quant flags.

mira: Andy, can you draft and ping #release-notes by EOD? I'll update deploybot command:
```
/deploy engine:v3.4.0-quant --canary=0.5% --ramp=24h --pin=48h --env PREFETCH=false
```

sre-bot: Reminder: night window circuit (23:00-02:00 UTC) enforced. Auto-rollback threshold: error-rate >1% or p95 latency increase >30% sustained 10m.

jon: added perf graphs to the doc (https://docs.internal/eng-runtime/perf/1234). If we see thermal/gpu-sched spikes, I'll abort.

mira: OK launching the scheduled dry-run tomorrow at 22:30 UTC for the smoke. If anybody objects speak now, else I'll proceed.

tess: no objections. :thumbsup: 

elena: I'll standby for rollback steps; have a rollback playbook ready (runbook/rollback-engine-v3.4.md).

deploy-bot: Dry-run executed at 2026-03-22T22:30Z — smoke OK on staging. Live canary still scheduled.

mira: Thanks team. Post-canary: we should capture a short note about the PREFETCH flag and add a runtime compatibility note to the RN.

andy: Drafted and posted to #release-notes. Link: https://slack.com/archives/RELEASE/abcd

mira: Closing loop here — will update thread after canary metrics. If anything trips thresholds, we'll abort and roll back immediately. If green, autos-pin remains in effect for 48h.
